annotation.title_clean: Real Decreto 517/2024, de 4 de junio, por el que se desarrolla el régimen jurídico para la utilización civil de sistemas de aeronaves no tripuladas (UAS)
annotation.title_en: Royal Decree 517/2024 of 4 June developing the legal regime for the civil use of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de la Presidencia, Justicia y Relaciones con las Cortes (Spain), Consejo de Ministros
annotation.summary_en: Spanish Royal Decree completing the EU drone framework (Regulations 2019/945, 2019/947, U-Space): defines national rules for non-EASA public-authority UAS activities, geographic zones, operator registration, training entities, minimum insurance, and competent authorities (AESA). Interior Ministry drone registry provisions were annulled by the Supreme Court in 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Completes EU UAS Delegated and Implementing Regulations and U-Space regime with national organisation and competences (AESA as lead authority).
Sets general UAS geographic zones (aerodromes, urban areas, critical infrastructure, military) with distance and altitude limits and coordination procedures.
Mandatory liability insurance for UAS of 20 kg or more and for certain open/specific/certified operations.
Creates rules for designated training entities, instructor certificates and national standard scenarios (STS-ES).
Articles 53-58 on Interior Ministry drone registry annulled by Supreme Court ruling of 19 June 2025.
